name: Yumsters 2: Around the World
shortDescription: Not only are these Yumsters crazy for strawberries, they can rock the bongos. For the love of fruity music, help them earn money by cleaning gardens to promote their band. To really skyrocket, Yumsters need the best equipment to win the ultimate grand prize at the fairy town music showdown.

name: Nancy Drew® Dossier: Lights, Camera, Curses!
shortDescription: Seek the source of sabotage on a Hollywood set!

name: LUXOR: Mah Jong
shortDescription: Embark on an epic quest to recover the stolen treasures of Ancient Egypt in LUXOR: Mah Jong. The fun and challenge is unending with 200 unique layouts available in 3 awesome play modes; Adventure, Single and Traditional.

name: Chainz 2: Relinked
shortDescription: It’s link-matching madness with Chainz 2: Relinked. Rotate the colored links to make matches of three or more in Classic Mode. Pit your link-matching skills against the clock in Arcade Mode. Ponder every precious move in Strategy Mode. Twist your brain and clear all the links in Puzzle Mode.

name: Midnight Mysteries
shortDescription: The master of macabre, Edgar Allan Poe, leads you on a shadowy journey to finally solve the mystery of his death. As a famed mystery writer, you’re looking for your next cold case to crack when an unexpected visitor hands you the perfect case to get your career moving again.

name: Metal Drift
shortDescription: Multiplayer team-based vehicular combat

name: Armored Fist 3
shortDescription: Command an entire fleet of M1A2 Abrams tanks in this brutal third installment in the Armored Fist series. Using the latest Abrams technology, the game presents the esteemed tank in its up-to-date form which is designed to survive biological, nuclear, and chemical warfare.

name: MiG-29 Fulcrum
shortDescription: The Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-29 Fulcrum is one of the world's most maneuverable and toughest fighter jets and has often been compared to its closest Western counterpart, the F-16. Innovations unique to the aircraft allow MiG pilots to perform remarkable moves like the Tailslide and Cobra maneuvers.

name: Zeit²
shortDescription: Zeit² brings a new twist to the traditional side-scrolling, 2D, shoot-’em-up game sporting a unique time travel feature never seen before in this genre.

name: Dawn of Magic 2
shortDescription: The well-known Action-RPG Dawn of Magic will now be continued as the evil forces won't leave the world without a desperate struggle after the death of the monstrous immortal Modo. Peace is ruined, the fragile balance of the forces that remained for 10 years has fallen into pieces.

name: Ziro
shortDescription: Once upon a time The Earth was green and beautiful. It was entrusted to humans to use it wisely together with all living things. Over time humans developed advanced technology using up the Earth’s natural resources. Humans lost their connection with the Earth.

name: The Search for Amelia Earhart
shortDescription: Follow Amelia Earhart’s life through space and time to learn about her accomplishments and discover what could have really happened to her on her last flight. Only you can discover the truth of what really happened on that long flight so many years ago!Features:Uncover history as you search for actual memorabilia left behind by Amelia.

name: Massive Assault
shortDescription: Take the command of Free Nations Union forces and defeat the Phantom League on one of six distant planets. The rebels decided to seize the power on Earth by first conquering the space colonies, which provide vital energy resources to AOG. The war for global domination unrolls on continents, at sea, and in the air.

name: Massive Assault: Phantom Renaissance
shortDescription: Massive Assault: Phantom Renaissance is the sequel to highly acclaimed turn-based strategy game Massive Assault. Massive Assault: Phantom Renaissance features a renewed global conflict between the Free Nations Union and Phantom League in distant space colonies.

name: Chronicles of Mystery: The Scorpio Ritual
shortDescription: Young archeologist Sylvie Leroux accidentally stumbles upon an ancient secret. What she doesn't realize is that her research will put her in deadly peril.

name: Big Brain Wolf
shortDescription: Big Brain Wolf is a hilarious point and click adventure game for puzzle lovers. The player takes upon the role of an asthmatic vegetarian wolf studying to become a genie. In the course of his adventures the player will encounter a large cast of famous funny characters and solve sixty different puzzles.

name: BRAINPIPE: A Plunge to Unhumanity
shortDescription: Brainpipe is a first person game of spatial navigation and quick reflexes. Supported by hypnotic graphics, ear tickling sound effects and immersive dreamscape music, the game's free floating, forward moving intensity gradually increases from serene to frenetic as you play.

name: Angle of Attack
shortDescription: Angle Of Attack is the aerial combat action companion title to All Aspect Warfare. It features high-octane air combat against air, land and sea threats over vast planetary regions. See the action from a different perspective and get in on the action!

name: All Aspect Warfare
shortDescription: All Aspect Warfare is a thrilling planetary combat game featuring first person, vehicular and air combat over vast terrain.

name: Quantz
shortDescription: Experience a new dimension of puzzle action game fun in QuantZ for the PC; a fabulous adventure that goes beyond the Action-Puzzler, Match-3 and Marble Popper genres. The gameplay is simple yet addictive: you have the power to control a cube with your mouse and drop marbles onto it.

name: Jewel Quest Pack
shortDescription: Includes the first three titles in the the ultimate jewel matching adventure, Jewel Quest! Rupert and Emma have settled down and opened a museum to display their many artifacts. While playing with a mysterious jewel board, their daughter unknowingly pops open a secret compartment.

name: Mahjong Quest Collection
shortDescription: Includes the first three installments of Mahjong Quest, the epic tale of tile matchmaking! What's the meaning of happiness? You are Kwazi. Starting from a mysterious birth at a mountaintop monastery and ending as a wizened old man, you use your grandfather's ancient Mah Jong set to solve an ever-challenging series of puzzles.

name: Coconut Queen
shortDescription: In Coconut Queen, the island of Lui Lui beckons you to bask amid miles of sun-drenched coastline. Disembark into its floral air, and discover that you are the island's much-awaited Coconut Queen. Your own private getaway is devoid of females, so find company among the brawny native gents who welcome you with succulent fruits.

name: Build-A-Lot
shortDescription: Send the housing market through the roof as you build, buy, and sell houses in the new strategy game, Build-a-lot! You can flip houses for quick cash or sit back and watch the rental income pile up. Become a real estate mogul as you visit scenic towns, earn huge profits and perform special favors for the colorful local mayors.

name: Build-A-Lot 2: Town of the Year
shortDescription: It’s time to get busy again building, buying and selling houses in Build-a-lot 2: Town of the Year! There are new towns to explore, new Mayors to meet and lots of money to be made as you cast your vote for the ‘Town of the Year’. Use your keen eye to pick the right locations to build parks and shops.

name: Build-A-Lot 3: Passport to Europe
shortDescription: Build-a-lot 3 is your passport to fun! Travel all over Europe as you restore rundown houses, develop friendly services and beautify neighborhoods with picturesque landmarks. name: Build-A-Lot 4: Power Source
shortDescription: The power is in your hands! Help friendly towns to grow and glow by building neighborhoods and generating clean energy to make them run. Watch out for power overload! If you build too fast, you may experience blackouts and unhappy renters.

name: Farm Frenzy: Pizza Party
shortDescription: Pizza lovers unite! It's time to return to the farm to create your favorite food! You'll start out by growing grass, feeding animals and collecting produce. Then you'll turn your goods into the ingredients you need to make different pizzas!

name: Farm Frenzy 3

name: Farm Frenzy 3: American Pie
shortDescription: Can you keep up with Scarlett and the latest advancements in technology as you grow crops, feed animals, collect produce and manufacture goods? Of course you can! Just don't let the zany new animations distract you from the task at hand.

name: Cradle of Rome

This legendary city was one of the most beautiful and powerful capitals to have ever existed in the ancient world! Resurrect the masterpieces of Roman architecture. The Coliseum will make a good training school for your brave gladiators.

name: Cradle of Persia
shortDescription: Build the mysterious heart of Ancient Persia in this engaging puzzle game! The original capital of the Achaemenid Empire was adorned with luxurious metals, gems and stone carvings, sure to have impressed peasants and visiting nobles alike.

name: Romance of Rome

Explore the strange universe where everything has a purpose.

name: Tommy Tronic

Jumping, shooting, dodging and exploring is all that's required to help get Tommy to his destination and free his tiny puppy from the clutches of an insane genius school-kid and his brutal sidekick 'Biffa'.

name: Death and the Fly
shortDescription: Control two very different characters, Death and the Fly. Each character has special skills that must be used to navigate the many traps and puzzles contained in each level.

name: Ion Assault

name: Hamilton's Great Adventure - Retro Fever DLC

The first expansion to the critically acclaimed Hearts of Iron III lets you take charge - or delegate - at any level, from division to nation, through a variety of scenarios.

name: Elven Legacy: Magic
shortDescription: The era of Elven Legacy is coming to an end. The relentless wave of demonic magical energy triggered by the death of the demon Farrakh has swept the world and has now reached the free city of Sylent. Powerless, the Masters of the Academy of Magic are being driven insane.

Find the lost parts and rebuild your ship along the way to solve challenging, physics-based puzzles. You can build your ship any way you like in the ship builder – try to find the coolest ship-design for the puzzle at hand!

Years ago humans along with the Arlings used Polygon-4 for a number of military experiments, but later left the test complex.

name: Real Warfare 1242

name: Armada 2526
shortDescription: Guide one of 12 races on their first interstellar journey from a single planet, until it becomes a mighty pan-galactic empire.

shortDescription: <p>Russia sought to seize control of Constantinople. The city controlled the Black Sea straits, an important economic and strategic point of the Black and Mediterranean Sea. This area was the cause of constant conflict with Britain, which was concerned about her Mediterranean interests.

shortDescription: <p>Spain tried to restore by force its influence on its former colonies, Chile and Peru. This strong Spanish squadron occupied the Chincha Islands, very important to the economy of Peru. Peru received support from neighboring Chile, Ecuador and Bolivia.

name: Escape From Paradise

The survivors of the shipwreck are very different from one another and decide to set up their own camps all over the island. Your goal is to find the pieces to a lost radio, and hoist it on the top of the volcano located in the center of the main island.

name: Escape From Paradise 2
shortDescription: Guide your hero to win the hand of his love by becoming the King of an island paradise. This sequel to the hit simulation game expands on everything you loved and adds a ton of new features. Expand your village by building, exploring and solving a variety of fun mini-games including Match-3, Hidden Object scenes, Gardening and more.

name: Book of Legends
shortDescription: If the Book of Legends should ever fall into the wrong hands, the consequences could be devastating. Follow Zoe and Charleston Black as they follow the clues found in the long forgotten Book of Legends…clues that lead them on a hunt for one of the world’s most mysterious legends of all, Excalibur! Is it real?

name: Voodoo Dice
shortDescription: Roll the dice in a mystical world filled with exploration, puzzle-solving, and adventure! Mixing action based and puzzle mechanics in a 3D world, Voodoo Dice is an innovative, challenging puzzler that plays with your mind to lead you to solve puzzles in unique and interesting ways.

name: Saira
shortDescription: Saira is a puzzle platformer with non-linear gameplay and a whole universe for you to explore. The game is heavily influenced by classic puzzle adventure games and uses a new unique graphical style combining high resolution photography into a lush and mysterious world.

name: Woody Two-Legs: Attack of the Zombie Pirates
shortDescription: Meet Woody Two-Legs, the least infamous pirate of Seven Seas. Things have never gone quite right for Woody. That is, until he scored big time and got his hands on huge treasure. Sailing to remote island, Woody was about to bury his treasure, just as any good pirate would do.

name: Professor Fizzwizzle and the Molten Mystery
shortDescription: <p>While on a well deserved vacation, Professor Fizzwizzle's investigation of a strange volcano has landed him in a Molten Mystery! Now it's up to you to master exciting new gadgets, outwit the Bat-Bots, and vanquish a truly cunning villain! Can the professor count on you to help?

name: Hidden Expedition: Amazon
shortDescription: Big Fish Games Studios takes you on an Adventure into the stunning world of the Amazon with the Hidden Expedition team in search of a missing professor. A tattered map referencing the legendary Beetle Temple is your only clue as you begin your adventure deep into the Amazon Rain forest.

name: Hidden Expedition: Everest
shortDescription: Fresh from a successful exploration of the wreck of the Titanic, the Hidden Expedition Club will pit one of its stellar members against a formidable group of opponents in a race to the summit of Everest. Other groups will battle you to be the first to summit Mount Everest. Expert Everest climber Ed Viesturs will assist you along the way.

name: Hidden Expedition: Titanic
shortDescription: On April 14, 1912, the great steamship RMS Titanic struck an iceberg and within hours it sank to the bottom of the Atlantic Ocean. As part of the Hidden Expedition Adventure League, it`s your job to explore the wreckage of this once-majestic ship and collect antique artifacts for the Titanic Museum.

name: Mystery Case Files: Madame Fate®
shortDescription: Madame Fate™, a mysterious fortune teller, has foreseen her own demise at midnight this very day. She has asked for your help in investigating each quirky carnival worker to determine their whereabouts at midnight.

name: Mystery Case Files: Prime Suspects™
shortDescription: The Queen's Hope Diamond has been stolen! It's up to you to search for clues throughout 22 levels, find the offending culprit, and recover the stolen gem. Expand your investigations through the game's 29 unique locations by finding items that will unlock subsequent levels.

name: Unwell Mel
shortDescription: <p>The doctor is in, with this madcap Match 3 game! Poor Mel has every ailment in the book, and you`re the only one who can cure him. Use your scanner to figure out what’s got him this time, whether it`s too much junk food, or some zany virus, and get to work.

name: Atlantis Sky Patrol
shortDescription: <p>This frenetic marble-popping adventure puts you in charge of how fast each level will end. Knock out doomsday devices on each of the 100 levels in the game by matching marble colors in sets of three.

name: Luxor: 5th Passage

Beware—while you scour the ocean floor in search of lost friends waiting for rescue, a host of enemies is lurking!

name: ProtoGalaxy
shortDescription: Earth is under siege! A mysterious and powerful alien race has come to enslave the entire galaxy, and your fleet is humanity's last hope. You must put an end to the attacks and rebuild a home for the survivors.

name: Fractal: Make Blooms Not War
shortDescription: Push, Combo, and Chain your way through a pulsing technicolor dreamscape all the while expanding your consciousness at 130 BPM.

name: Cosmic Osmo and the Worlds Beyond the Mackerel

name: The Manhole: Masterpiece Edition

name: Dive to the Titanic
shortDescription: 100 years after the tragic sinking of the Titanic, re-discover this epic maritime story and explore the wreck 100 years later.

name: Diamond Dan
shortDescription: Dragged into Archeology by his uncle, Dan decides to take matters into his own hands. He discovers ancient temples with long lost treasures and menacing traps. Dan follows the clues found in the temples which leads him on a trip across the world, bringing him ever closer to making a sensational discovery.

name: Puzzle Bots
shortDescription: There’s a big secret at Dr. Hugo’s Factory for Making Robots. When the inventors aren’t looking, their tiny robots go on big adventures. They never expected to stumble onto a plot so diabolical it threatened their very existence. With lasers.

shortDescription: Blue Toad Murder Files™: The Mysteries of Little Riddle is a one to four player co-operative episodic download game published by Relentless Software. Set in the sleepy village of Little Riddle, the main aim of the game is to follow clues to find the murderer.

name: Ancients of Ooga

name: Steel Storm: Burning Retribution

You can join with any of several factions and reach dozens of different endings.

name: Geneforge 3
shortDescription: Geneforge 3 is an Indie fantasy role-playing adventure, the third chapter of the Geneforge Saga. In this fantasy adventure, you can explore strange, hostile lands, choose which side you will fight for, and, as always, make your own horde of completely obedient mutant monsters. Geneforge 3 has a huge and open storyline.

name: Geneforge 4: Rebellion
shortDescription: Geneforge 4: Rebellion is an Indie fantasy role-playing adventure, the fourth chapter of the Geneforge Saga. Once again, return to the world of the Shapers, where you will explore a vast world, choose what side you will fight for, and create and mold your own army of strange, powerful monsters.

name: Geneforge 5: Overthrow
shortDescription: Geneforge 5: Overthrow is an Indie fantasy role-playing adventure, the final chapter of the epic Geneforge Saga. Return to the world of the Shapers one final time. Explore a vast, war-torn world, create and mold your own army of strange, powerful monsters, and choose a side to help lead to final victory.

name: Pox Nora
shortDescription: Delve into classic turn-based strategy gaming with elements of table top miniatures, fantasy RPG and TCG style gameplay all wrapped into one.

name: EverQuest II
shortDescription: EverQuest® II is a deep fantasy MMORPG with over two decades of content, a thriving world, and ongoing expansions that keep Norrath growing. Create your hero and adventure through a massively rich, ever-evolving universe.

name: Scary Girl
shortDescription: In this side-scrolling action game, you play as Scarygirl – a girl who has been adopted by a giant intelligent octopus and is trying to figure out who the man haunting her dreams is. Traverse unique, extremely vibrant, colorful, and magical worlds in a seamless mix of 2D and 3D platforming action.

name: Scoregasm
shortDescription: Scoregasm is an incredible, variety rich shooter with a non-linear, branching paths style galaxy to explore. It's pretty, accessible, fun and really rather good! Blast your way through the galaxy's many varied levels and use your skills to change your route, find new levels, new enemies, unlock bonus challenge stages and fight the bosses...

name: Midnight Mysteries: Salem Witch Trials
shortDescription: The famed writer Nathaniel Hawthorne has died during a freak snow storm, and his ghost has come to you, asking for help. There’s more to this case than first appears, and only you can help free his spirit. Why was it snowing in May?

name: Midnight Mysteries 3: Devil on the Mississippi
shortDescription: Down by the deep and muddy Mississippi, something’s not right. A ghostly riverboat brings to light a new conspiracy for players to unravel in this all-new Midnight Mystery. Mark Twain’s ghost has come to you seeking help from an evil that has been stalking him in the afterlife.

name: Midnight Mysteries 4: Haunted Houdini
shortDescription: Famed illusionist Harry Houdini knew he wouldn’t escape death forever. When he promised his wife that he would try to reach her from the afterlife, it was seen as the ultimate stunt But after years of séances, Bess was never able to reach Harry in this life or the next, and her spirit has come to you in a final plea to reunite her with...

name: Roller Coaster Rampage
shortDescription: Roller Coaster Rampage introduces an innovative approach, and a specialized procedural coaster engine that allows players to build coasters in real-time as they ride them.

name: Cannon Fodder 3
shortDescription: Cannon Fodder 3 is a tactical action game, which inherited the style and traditions of the original game. The war goes on and its scale is nearly the same as before. 500 conscripts are sent to meet their destiny. What awaits them? A general's stars or a bed of honor?

name: Highborn
shortDescription: This witty, wacky, turn-based strategy game is now available for Steam. In Highborn, you’re treated to a strategy game that offers an intelligent, tactical experience without the frenetic play of a traditional RTS.

name: Spirits
shortDescription: Autumn is quickly approaching, and the spirits of fallen leaves are setting out on their journey home. Guide them by changing how the wind blows or by rebuilding the ground.

name: Dead Hungry Diner
shortDescription: Dead Hungry Diner is all about big combos, spells, monsters fighting monsters and finding your flow within the monstrous mayhem!Help Gabe and Gabby, patrons of “The Dead Hungry Diner”, as they feed the creatures of the night buckets and buckets of juicy Brain Berry goop!(Well... that’s the easy part!

name: Sugar Cube: Bittersweet Factory
shortDescription: A cube of sugar escapes the factories to avoid the fate of being a cookie!

name: Party of Sin
shortDescription: Take control of the Seven Deadly Sins as you forge your destiny on a quest to troll humanity.

name: Super Crate Box
shortDescription: Vlambeer's SUPER CRATE BOX is coming to bring back the glory of the golden arcade age, when all that really mattered was getting on that high score list. Grab your baseball cap and loosen your pants, it's time to fight endless hordes of enemies and collect every weapon crate you can.

name: Atooms to Moolecules Demo
shortDescription: Atooms to Moolecules is a chemistry based puzzle game. In this game you are in a Chemistry lab, your task is to solve different puzzles. You can arrange atoms to make ring, linear, small or big molecules and have fun with them. The game is played in different lab equipment.

name: Dwarfs - F2P
shortDescription: Dwarfs!? is an addictive, fast paced arcade-like experience, with plenty of difficulty levels and game modes, in the tradition of great games such as “Lemmings” and “Dwarf Fortress”.

name: Ragnarok Online
shortDescription: In the world of Rune Midgard, it was a time of strife between the Gods, Humans and demons...Battle weary from the long war's carnage, the factions entered into an uneasy truce. The truce grew into a fragile peace that lasted for a thousand years.

name: Zombie Playground™
shortDescription: Zombie Playground is a single player or coop online, action arena game with RPG elements. The game combines childhood nostalgia with horrific monsters, visceral combat, and a unique atmosphere straight out of a child’s nightmares.

name: Shad'O
shortDescription: In this uniqueTower Defense you will travel through William’s mind in a colored and dreamlike universe.

name: Dungeon-Party
shortDescription: Dungeon Party is a free online game that is played in teams. You are plunged into a totally crazy, heroic-fantasy world, where you compete in teams of heroes in dungeons full of deadly traps and awesome monsters to win the treasures they are trying so hard to hide.

name: Sleeping Dogs: Ghost Pig
shortDescription: Become the elusive movie star with the Ghost Pig mask. Dogeyes’ black fedora hat, an assassin’s straw hat, and a lone sheriff’s hat are also included in this free pack.

name: Luxor: Amun Rising HD
shortDescription: Glory and adventure await as you return to save Ancient Egypt from certain doom in Luxor: Amun Rising. As chains of colored spheres rapidly approach the gateway of the pyramids, it’s up to you to stop them with your magical winged-scarab shooter. Fire colored orbs to make matches of three or more and eliminate oncoming chains.

name: Waves 2: Notorious
shortDescription: Waves 2: Notorious is an arcade twin-stick shooter set in Cyberspace. Build Combos, earn Adrenaline and unleash powerful Burst attacks as you Dive into the Net and do battle against an AI that adapts to your weaknesses!

name: Nethergate: Resurrection
shortDescription: Spiderweb Software's classic adventure of treachery and battle in ancient times has returned! Travel back to ancient Britannia for a tale of cunning foes, vicious battles, and a race to rediscover the lost secrets of magic. Britannia is a land ravaged by war.

name: Democracy 2
shortDescription: On Tuesday, November 6th Americans will vote to shape the future of their country. Why wait? Start shaping your country's future now in Democracy 2.

name: iBomber Attack
shortDescription: The legendary iBomber series returns but this time it’s time to ATTACK! Jump into your tank and get ready to blast your way around Europe and defeat the enemy in this visceral tour of destruction! With 24 missions full of explosive action to go at, iBomber Attack is a dose of high-octane entertainment that you won’t be able to put down.

name: Angelica Weaver: Catch Me When You Can
shortDescription: Building on the successes of their award-winning Midnight Mysteries adventure series, MumboJumbo has created an all-new adventure franchise. Boasting interactive backgrounds, story-driven puzzles, an animated main character, voice acting and a rich narrative filled with twists and turns, Angelica Weaver: Catch Me When You Can is...

name: Miner Wars Arena
shortDescription: Fast-paced arcade game inspired by the classic PC game, Tunneler, with state-of-the-art top-down view, 2.5D gameplay in a fully destructible environment. Enjoy unlimited gameplay variation by adjusting arena settings, such as terrain, map size, number of AI-controlled bots, technology level and many more.

name: Dogs of War Online
shortDescription: Dogs Of War Online is a multiplayer tactical game, based on the classic board game "Confrontation". Build your own company of mercenaries from the wide range of units available and challenge thousands of players in intense battles.

name: Nancy Drew®: The Deadly Device
shortDescription: An Elusive Killer Shocks a High-Tech Lab!

name: Jack Lumber
shortDescription: A tree killed his granny and now he is out for revenge. Meet Jack Lumber, the supernatural lumberjack who hates trees, loves animals, and hates trees. Did we say that twice? The guy really hates trees, and boy does he have an axe to grind.

name: Mushroom Men: Truffle Trouble
shortDescription: Truffle Trouble is a unique game featuring Pax, the hero of Mushroom Men, that combines classic platforming action with imaginative puzzle-solving as you must move, stack, and use objects to create new paths to jump and clamber on, all while the besotted Truffle Princess draws ever closer.

name: Rail Adventures - VR Tech Demo
shortDescription: The Rail Adventures VR Tech Demo is a free product, showcasing the upcoming action game Rail Adventures.

name: Champions of Regnum
shortDescription: Choose your Realm and engage in the most dynamic player driven battlefield available on any MMO. Fight for the Alsius Empire, protect the woods of Syrtis or avenge the Brotherhood of Ignis.

name: Train Simulator: Pacific Surfliner® LA - San Diego Route
shortDescription: It’s not all beaches and surfing in California – the stunning Pacific Surfliner® LA – San Diego route for Train Simulator takes you through some of the US state’s most stunning scenery, past golden beaches and into sprawling cityscapes.

name: Train Simulator: West Somerset Railway Route Add-On
shortDescription: The longest heritage railway in the UK comes to life in the beautiful West Somerset Railway route add-on for Train Simulator, available now.The origins of what is now one of the favourite preserved railways for enthusiasts began back in the mid-1800s, when a number of proposals were submitted for railway schemes in west Somerset;...

name: Train Simulator: East Coast Main Line London-Peterborough Route Add-On
shortDescription: One of the busiest routes on the British rail network springs to life in the stunning East Coast Main Line London-Peterborough route for Train Simulator, featuring the classic High Speed Train and commuter Class 365 EMU.

name: 7 Wonders: Ancient Alien Makeover
shortDescription: The long-standing 7 Wonders series keeps getting better and better! The fifth installment, 7 Wonders: Ancient Alien Makeover, adds an entirely new game component, new Wonders and a new and exciting material – Alien Energy!

name: Project Eagle: A 3D Interactive Mars Base
shortDescription: An interactive art demo that showcases what a future base on Mars could look like. Project Eagle isn't a game - but an exploration of mankind's possible future.

name: Warp Frontier
shortDescription: In the year 2215, orbiting humanity's newest extrasolar colony, Police Captain Vincent Cassini becomes embroiled in an intersystem conspiracy to bury crimes that occurred during the war that devastated his planet.

name: Hacker Evolution IMMERSION
shortDescription: Mankind is about to reach its next step of evolution. Uncover the dark secret behind mankind's fastest technological evolution in recent history. It's not going in the right direction.

name: Armada 2526 Gold Edition
shortDescription: Conquer the Galaxy In This ‘4x’ Strategy Game. Lead one of 18 different alien races to become a mighty pan-galactic empire. Manage your colonies, deploy your fleets and conduct research. Plot your strategy and turn your planets into mighty bastions.

name: CSX SD70MAC Add-on Livery
shortDescription: This DLC is only available to purchase in the USA.In order to be able to use this add-on livery product, you MUST first own the SD70 V2 Volume 2 Loco Add-on. If you check in the in-game store it will verify if you own it before you purchase.

name: Max Gentlemen
shortDescription: Max Gentlemen is an arcade-style extreme manners simulator about stacking hats.

name: Probability 0
shortDescription: Never reach the bottom of the pit that is Probability 0. The game is different every time you die: the enemies you fight, the landscape you climb down, and the body you inhabit (if you so choose). Never survive. But find your way deeper than you did last time.

name: Wooden Sen'SeY
shortDescription: Wooden Sen'SeY is an action-platformer, set in a unique "Japan Steam Rock" universe filled with humour. You follow Goro, a village chief, as he seeks revenge through a variety of levels. He will defeat his enemies using his axes to slice, dice, squash and grapple!

name: YOU DON'T KNOW JACK MOVIES
shortDescription: YDKJ: Movies is considered the most challenging game in the series – are you up for the challenge? Test your movie knowledge from back when movies were movies, and movie candy didn't have high fructose corn syrup!

name: Haunted
shortDescription: In this comedy of terrors, the fate of the spirit world is in your hands as you embark on a search for your long-lost sibling!

name: The Real Texas
shortDescription: The Real Texas is an action RPG taking place in Strange, Texas: a Kafka-esque parody stuck halfway between modern-day America and olden-days, RPG England.

name: Trench Run
shortDescription: Trench Run is a mayhem-filled, laugh a minute casual 4-player action game brought to you by the makers of King Arthur’s Gold and Soldat.

name: C-RUSH
shortDescription: C-RUSH is an old school Shooter, with HD graphics.A new threat is coming from the space; the plasma insects. Exterminate the vermin!!Beat your own score and compare it with the other players !Key Features:- One ship with different positions to use- Different Gameplay according to the positions and shoots- A Schmup where you need...

name: Postmortem: One Must Die (Extended Cut)
shortDescription: Narrative-adventure playing an Agent of Death who must take ONE life that could change the fate of a conflict-torn Nation

name: Jacob Jones and the Bigfoot Mystery : Episode 1
shortDescription: Join Camp Eagle Feathers’ newest ‘Brave’, Jacob Jones, on an amazing adventure to uncover just what is going on at Camp Eagle Feather.

name: Lost Civilization
shortDescription: Race to unearth the mystery of a forgotten civilization and rescue your kidnapped fiancé in this atmospheric adventure, suitable for beginners and diehards alike, which features a haunting blend of puzzle-solving and investigation.

name: Moot District
shortDescription: Build and defend! Make Moot District yours!

name: SUPERVERSE
shortDescription: SUPERVERSE is a fast-paced, action-packed space shooter that launches you into an ancient network of interconnected universes. Your mission: travel back through space-time and prevent the extinction of humanity.

name: b 2
shortDescription: b 2: online multiplayer an alien place you are the bee: fly where you like, play as you like

name: Angel Legion
shortDescription: Idle or play whenever and wherever you want. Customize the looking of your favorite Angels. Automatically accumulate resources all the time.

name: Jungle Town: Birthday quest
shortDescription: A colorful educational adventure for children ages 2–5. Join six friendly animals, solve simple puzzles, find hidden objects, and practice attention, fine motor skills, and everyday habits while preparing a birthday surprise for the baby elephant. Play offline, with no adult help required.

name: Ukrainian Soccer  ( any two points directed towards the net can score )
shortDescription: This game allows to create scoring opportunities from many angles simultaneously what makes for a dynamic and exciting play. Direct any two points from your team towards the opponent's net and score. First party to score wins. It also features three board designs with zoom.

name: Battle Teams 2
shortDescription: Battle Teams 2 is a fast-paced multiplayer tactical shooter with Asian aesthetics. PvP offers action-packed game modes set in a rigorously balanced competitive gameplay environment. Cooperative PvE gameplay throws you and your friends into wave after wave of merciless adversaries.

name: The Deadly Path
shortDescription: Aid the Deities of Dread in their quest for vengeance and pave the way for their ascension. Gather grim materials, construct defences and expand the underworld to appease the rage of the gods in The Deadly Path, a unique building management and roguelike strategy game.

name: Ominoflux
shortDescription: Ominoflux will test your brain in a most peculiar way.

name: Tempest Tower
shortDescription: Tempest Tower is an action packed tower defense platformer where you must brawl with incoming hordes of Creepers while herding the local critters to safety. Build, fight, upgrade, overcome.

name: Patchkins Party
shortDescription: Patchkins is a multiplayer racing game for 2 to 8 players where you build the course as you play. Each round, players draw and place objects like Platforms, Obstacles, and Specials, then race to the finish without dying.

name: Chronicle Archive - Japan
shortDescription: Explore history like never before in Chronicle Archive - Japan! Customize your avatar, solve puzzles, collect badges, and connect with players worldwide in this immersive multiplayer adventure.

name: AstroScaper
shortDescription: Colonize barren asteroids and transform them into thriving space colonies. Discover powerful building synergies, solve satisfying placement puzzles, and journey from one procedurally generated world to the next.

name: Frontier Force Vanguard
shortDescription: Frontier Force Vanguard is an open-world, turn-based RPG where you take on missions and build your reputation and supports the Empire expansion.

name: Sad Virus Foodland
shortDescription: Walking simulation and adventure game where player controls virus character in foodland. Mission to avoid obstacles and find beer bottle

name: Rat Run
shortDescription: Jump your way through endless obstacles and smash incoming enemies as a cheese-thirsty rat! Accelerate to the maximum speed and unlock all biomes and playable rodents!

name: Monkey Wave
shortDescription: Monkey Wave is a fast-paced action clicker where you defend your banana stash against waves of hostile apes. Click rapidly to defeat primates and epic bosses in solo, co-op, and PvP modes. Deploy strategic abilities and survive the chaos of the jungle.

name: Hello Anxiety
shortDescription: Hello Anxiety is a pixel art narrative puzzle RPG set in a surreal world shaped by mental health struggles. Navigate eerie bookstores, silent streets, and haunting memories as you explore the layers of anxiety and self-doubt in this emotional, story-driven experience.

name: Eyes Of The ElderWood
shortDescription: Eyes Of The ElderWood is a first-person adventure horror set in Kashubian folklore, emphasizing diverse locations, challenges, and enemies. Draw spells to solve puzzles and deal with foes, or fight using a revolver. Keep an eye on your sanity level to avoid descending into madness.

name: Dream about yoU
shortDescription: A dashing blond partner drops in from the sky, declaring they're taking responsibility for you—but they need a small favor.Find them in your dreams, wake them up, and crack the dream maze. Sci-fi comedy, adventure starts now!

name: One Tower Defense
shortDescription: One Tower Defense is a Roguelike Tower Defense game where you control a single tower. Gather resources, buy weapons and upgrades, and fight endless waves of enemies. Play in single-player mode or in multiplayer mode, where the last survivor wins.

name: Police Chief Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
shortDescription: Free introduction to the full Police Chief Simulator game takes you to Winston Springs Police Station! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

name: AxeSlinger
shortDescription: AxeSlinger is a fast, movement based roguelite FPS where you shred through enemy infested dimensions using guitar weapons. Fight hordes, rack up insane combos, unlock abilities, and battle colossal bosses as The AxeSlinger on your path to ultimate power!

name: Restitutor: Empire Restored
shortDescription: Restitutor is a historical incremental grand strategy game focused on statecraft, diplomacy, and calculated warfare. Strengthen your economy, research new technologies, form alliances, and outmaneuver rivals through high-level strategic decisions without micromanagement.

name: Arrow Flow
shortDescription: Welcome to Arrow Flow - a stylish, minimalist puzzle game where every decision requires care and thoughtful strategy. Use logic and spatial thinking to direct all the arrows to the exit and prevent them from crossing.

name: Martha's Dolls 2
shortDescription: The viral horror hit returns. Step into the haunting ruins of the Martha's House , where every shadow conceals a threat and the porcelain dolls aren't just watching , they're hunting you.

name: Novel Forger: Suicide Mr. Fury
shortDescription: Suicide Mr. Fury is a Meta-Otome adventure that deconstructs the absurdity of falling for someone who doesn’t exist. Navigate branching paths, meta-narratives, and a multiverse of madness with the overbearing CEO, Mr. Fury, between digital delusion and harsh reality.

name: Slot Theory
shortDescription: A roguelike tower defense where every draft permanently mutates your build. Stack modifiers, trigger massive Surge events, and watch your defenses evolve into unstable, compounding systems that fight in ways you didn’t design.

name: Clutch Legend: FPS Career Simulator
shortDescription: Build a Counter-Strike-inspired esports career from nobody to legend. Master weapons, develop your skills, negotiate contracts, hire staff, and play or simulate every match on your road to the Major.

name: Dawn of Horror
shortDescription: Dawn of Horror is a fast-paced, brutal cyberpunk Battle Royale set in the decaying urban sprawl of Cygnus City, 2221. Following the collapse of civilization into a digital Dark Age, scavengers fight over the remaining ruins. Drop in, gear up, hack the system, and be the last one breathing.

name: BUNKER: RED FLAG
shortDescription: A global catastrophe has struck the world. A small group of survivors is trapped in an isolated shelter with resources too scarce for everyone. Take your seat at the table, convince the others you deserve to stay. Lie, pressure, manipulate – and decide who gets thrown out!

name: KESU-JI
shortDescription: KESU-JI is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics. (Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode) You can aim for high scores on the online leaderboards in each mode and earn rewards. Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

name: Pocket Dinos
shortDescription: An incremental dino collection game where prehistoric stickers come to life. Hatch eggs, discover unique variants, build thriving habitats, and uncover powerful combinations to grow your fortune.

name: DEMON SIEGE
shortDescription: Stack ridiculous power-ups infinitely in this retro-inspired FPS Bullet Heaven. Build completely broken combinations as you go from a lowly demon hunter to an unstoppable demon-slaying GOD. Includes Story Mode with multiple endings and Endless Mode.

name: Castleborne Survivors
shortDescription: A survivors-like game with side-scrolling action combat. Slash, dodge, and mow down endless monsters in a gothic horror castle. Upgrade with every choice, snowball out of control, and survive until the very end.

name: Source aged like fine wine: ballad of jets
shortDescription: A short, visceral, and physics-heavy descent into a personal third place. Spawn objects, defy the mockery of the void, and reach the flag before the burnout wins. Spawn lightweight Jets entities who smell nice, even when the world feels like a burden for you. Just dunno, puzzle game.

name: Toll: The Ferryman's Ledger
shortDescription: You are Charon. You take the coins from the eyes of the dead — and one of them, someday, must be your own. A short incremental with a real ending: five rivers, a tribute owed to Hades, and a price on your own freedom. It ends. That is the whole point.

name: Token x Token x Clicker
shortDescription: Run a tiny 3D office of robot employees — the Grammis — and pick up the token embers they drop. Win contracts on the lottery reel, ride out overtime rushes, renovate your one-room startup into a corporate tower, and climb to #1 in the market cap rankings. 200+ collectibles. Fully local.

name: CapyCam
shortDescription: There's no fuss here. There's only golden light, rustling grass, and dozens of friendly faces. Look for capybaras in the thicket, but remember the most important rule of photography: to capture the perfect shot, sometimes you just need to lower the camera.

name: CrystalStack
shortDescription: Build the tallest crystal tower you can. CrystalStack is a 3D physics-based stacking game developed with Unreal Engine 5. Carefully place transparent crystal cubes, keep your balance, and beat your highest score before the tower collapses. Relaxing to play, challenging to master.
